{{Top|leg}}
'''Sonic motivators''' were part of a fountain located in a clearing in [[The Greenwell]] of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. They were used to propel [[Water/Legends|water]] into the air in a decorative pattern of whirls and eddies.
